messages:
lian: Heads-up — helm upgrade for infra/inference-release v2.9 failed during pre-install CRD hook. Canary rollout is blocked. Deploy bot shows the job stuck in CrashLoopBackOff.

ashok: on it. which hook job name? any logs? :eyes:

lian: job is `gpu-pool-crd-apply` in namespace `infra`. quick logs: 
```
I0203 10:02:11 main.go:45] applying CRD gpu.redwood.ai/v1
E0203 10:02:12 main.go:78] failed to write to PVC: permission denied
F0203 10:02:13 main.go:80] exit status 1
```

deploy-bot: upgrade failed: pre-install hook job "gpu-pool-crd-apply" failed (CrashLoopBackOff) — release "inference-release" has been rolled back to previous revision.

marta: hmm permission denied writing to PVC — RBAC or storageClass change? we recently migrated CSI driver in us-west2 last week. could be related.

sam: FYI helm rollback doesn't touch CRDs, so we still have the partially-applied resources. high-level options: (1) delete the hook job + fix RBAC + re-run upgrade, (2) run upgrade with `--skip-crds` and apply CRDs manually, (3) temporarily disable gpu pool to let canary proceed.

ashok: agree. quick mitigation I propose: 
1) `kubectl -n infra delete job gpu-pool-crd-apply`
2) patch RBAC: `kubectl -n infra apply -f rbac-patch.yaml` (adds `create` on `persistentvolumeclaims`)
3) apply CRD manually: `kubectl apply -f crds/gpu-pool-crd.yaml`
4) helm upgrade with `--timeout 10m --wait`

ops-ci: running a dry-run terraform plan now to check for drift on GPU pools and quotas in us-west2. there was an alert showing desired_count > gpu_quota for Redwood-prod yesterday.

marta: also check controller-manager logs for webhook errors — we had an API change for CRD conversion webhook on kube 1.27 that showed up in the last platform patch. might need an annotation tweak.

sam: created INFRA-3242: "CRD hook job failure during helm upgrade; investigate RBAC/CSI/drift; blocked canary" with rollback steps and owner @lian. attaching notes. :memo:

lian: thanks. i'll delete the job and apply the RBAC patch now, then manually apply the CRD and re-run the upgrade with `--set gpuPool.enabled=false` if the CRD still blocks canary. will post updates here. :thumbsup:

ashok: one more note: if we disable the gpu pool in helm values, confirm autoscaler config in terraform matches so we don't get orphaned nodes.

lian: noted — will coordinate with ops-ci on terraform. updating INFRA-3242 with terraform plan output.

deploy-bot: action queued: `kubectl delete job gpu-pool-crd-apply -n infra` by lian.

lian: done — job deleted, RBAC patch applied, manual CRD apply started. logs show CRD accepted. re-running helm upgrade with `--wait`.

marta: good work. follow up: add an integration test for CRD hook run in our release pipeline so hooks that touch PVCs run in a sandbox before prod.

sam: agree — adding test ticket to INFRA-3242.

lian: will keep this thread updated during the rollout.
